title: Downtown Chicago City Tour In a Lamborghini[60 Minute Experience]
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb:
Experience Chicago in unparalleled style with a 10-mile cruise through the city in a luxury or exotic vehicle. Glide through iconic streets, turning heads at every stop, while taking in the captivating sights of the Windy City. Whether you're a resident or visitor, this exclusive ride offers a fresh perspective of Chicago's vibrant energy and charm. Don’t miss the chance to explore the city like never before—reserve your adventure and drive through Chicago’s heart in true sophistication. All tour vehicles are subject to availability

During This Ride You May See Views Of The Following Land Marks:

Little Italy
Willis Tower
Harold Washington Library
The Chicago Theatre
Millennium Park
Grant Park
Buckingham Fountain
Magnificent Mile
Gold Coast
Museum of Science & Industry
Lake Michigan
And much more!
We cannot guarantee that all sites on this list will be seen in your tour.
